commands: echo "RUN_ID=${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-unset} ATTEMPT=${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT:-unset}"; git status --porcelain; echo "---PRVIEW---"; gh pr view 1879 --json headRefName,baseRefName,baseRefOid,headRefOid,body,closingIssuesReferences --jq '.'

for f in skills/docs-verify/SKILL.md skills/review-and-fix/references/shadow-review.md; do
  before=$(git show b45e66bb6cbac142b5b926c37ae0d83d65573bef:"$f" 2>/dev/null | wc -c)
  after=$(wc -c < "$f")
  echo "$f: before=$before after=$after delta=$((after-before))"
done

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
